title: CPCSC Level 1 logical access enforcement needs authorization and decisions
remediation: The sponsor access control owner maps logical access rules to specified contract information and assessed resources. Review effective permissions and record a permitted role accessing its assigned resource and a refused request by a role without that authorization. Document inherited access control with the accountable service owner. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect approved resource and role mappings, effective permissions and dated allowed and refused access evidence
